title: 策略师谢毅哲：美元短期强势，明年或降息走弱
speaker: Unnamed Guest

segments.en: Let's have a look at the dollar. The context right now is a resurgent US dollar.
segments.zh: 我们来看看美元。当前背景是美元再度走强。

segments.en: We're now thinking about not so much of the Fed hikes but how much they're able to hike. How does this play into your strategy?
segments.zh: 我们现在考虑的不是美联储加息多少，而是他们能加多少。这对你的策略有何影响？

segments.en: Well, I mean definitely because of the expectation from cut to hike, US dollar has strengthened against the other currency in particular Japanese yen because of the carry.
segments.zh: 嗯，确实因为预期从降息转向加息，美元兑其他货币走强，尤其是日元，因为利差交易。

segments.en: But our house view is okay, we're not expecting a hike this year but we do expect a cut in next year, two cuts, 350 basis point.
segments.zh: 但我们内部观点是，今年不会加息，但明年会降息两次，共350个基点。

segments.en: So we are, you know, advising investors is okay, yes, near term, probably US dollar was still strength well. Not strength and thought, but at least hold up.
segments.zh: 所以我们建议投资者，短期内美元可能仍保持强势，至少是持稳。

segments.en: But moving into next year because of this because all the other currencies already have hike if they need to.
segments.zh: 但进入明年，因为其他货币如果需要已经加息了。

segments.en: So in a way that if US were to cut and maybe other currency even match or not matching US dollar was soft and a little that was going back to the, I'm not saying that we're going back to the digitalization trend but at least the strengthening you got to be cautious that it could be worse in 2027.
segments.zh: 所以如果美国降息，而其他货币跟进或不跟进，美元会走软，我不是说回到数字化趋势，但至少走强要谨慎，2027年可能更糟。
